integrity: Analytical proof with a separately executable finite symbolic/numerical consistency checker; publication priority provisional; no external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for real planar Gaussian-polynomial Fourier +1 eigenfunctions of total polynomial degree at most four vanishing at the origin; no unrestricted or higher-degree definite-set bound is asserted.
title: A sharp planar negative-set inequality in the fourth Hermite Fourier band
